title: Make a wide picture
prompt: Make a wide picture of a lighthouse at night and save it as banner.png.
check: head -c4 banner.png | tail -c3 | grep -q PNG && { grep -aq 'W=1024 H=576' banner.png || ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0 banner.png | awk -F, '{exit !($1 > $2)}'; }
